name: blue-horizon-selenium-e2e
description: Blue Horizon QA Automation — 326+ real-time tests: Selenium E2E, Load, Vulnerability, Unit, Appium Mobile

scripts.test:chrome: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=false npm run test
scripts.test:chrome:headless: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true npm run test
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox HEADLESS=false npm run test
scripts.test:edge: cross-env BROWSER=edge HEADLESS=false npm run test
scripts.test:all:selenium: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true npm run test:selenium
scripts.test:all:security: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true npm run test:security
scripts.e2e:selenium: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true npm run test:selenium && npm run report:excel && npm run report:html
scripts.e2e:full: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true npm run test && npm run report:excel && npm run report:html
scripts.e2e: cross-env BROWSER=chrome HEADLESS=true mocha "tests/specs/unit-tests.spec.js" "tests/specs/load-tests.spec.js" "tests/specs/authentication.spec.js" "tests/specs/ui-validation.spec.js" "tests/specs/admin-dashboard.spec.js" "tests/specs/driver-dashboard.spec.js" "tests/specs/parent-dashboard.spec.js" "tests/specs/navigation.spec.js" "tests/specs/ui-forms-validation.spec.js" "tests/specs/vulnerability-tests.spec.js" "tests/specs/appium-mobile.spec.js" --require tests/hooks/setup.js --require tests/hooks/teardown.js --timeout 180000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=reports/html,reportFilename=mochawesome,overwrite=false,html=true,json=true && npm run report:excel && npm run report:html
